articles.summary: ATLANTA , Dec. 10, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oxford Industries, Inc. (NYSE:OXM) today announced financial results for its third quarter of fiscal 2025 ended November 1, 2025 . Consolidated net sales in the third quarter of fiscal 2025 were $307 million compared to $308 million in the third quarter
articles.title: Oxford: Owner of Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer and Johnny Was Reports Third Quarter Results
